meta.rule: A hotel is usable for an 8 AM–close day only if the walk from the lobby to the Venetian poker room can be completed inside 30 minutes.
meta.how_to_close: CLOSED 2026-11-17. Measured via Google Maps walking directions for all 10 hotel→Venetian pairs (data/integrated/walks-google.json). The ≤30-minute filter is now a hard filter driven by these measured values. Re-run each directions URL to refresh; a moved route is a change-monitor trigger.

measurement_source.method: Google Maps directions, travel mode = walking, departure 'leave now'. Each pair was opened as a directions URL built from the hotel's official address and the poker room's official address; the duration, the distance and the route summary printed by Google were copied verbatim into this file with the time of the request. Re-capture with: python3 tools/walk_capture.py
measurement_source.why_measured_not_published: No Strip operator publishes a door-to-door walking time to another property's poker room, so a minute count can only come from a routing engine. These are measurements with a timestamp and a source URL — they are labelled as such and never presented as an official statement.
measurement_source.extended_by: 2026-11-18, session arena/ebf43d3b-poker4: added linq and flamingo (official addresses printed on caesars.com; walks re-run on the same Google Maps walking URL format)
